title: Now browse on your own computer
drDigitalIntro:
You have navigated, searched, opened tabs and closed a scam popup in the practice browser. Now use yours.
• Open your browser and type a website address you know straight into the address bar.
• Open a second tab and search for something in it, then switch between the two tabs.
• Look for the padlock in the address bar and check it is there before typing anything personal.
• Close the tabs you no longer need. A browser with thirty tabs open is slower and harder to use.
drDigitalSuccess: That is the same browser you practised on, with real websites in it.
drDigitalHint: Read along, then open your own browser and try each step.
